about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Fullstack developer focused on results for your business
about.p1: I'm a fullstack web developer with over 10 years of experience building web applications, landing pages, and APIs for businesses in Mexico. I specialize in ASP.NET and Angular, technologies I use to build everything from corporate sites to full enterprise platforms.
about.p2: I work with you from day one: I understand what your business needs, propose the best technical solution, and deliver it working. No jargon, no unnecessary complexity. Clear communication, on-time delivery, quality code.
about.p3: My core stack includes Angular, Svelte, ASP.NET, C#, PostgreSQL, and TypeScript. With these, I can build virtually any web project you have in mind — from a landing page to a full system with users, payments, and dashboards.
about.p4: I work from Querétaro alongside four feline supervisors who ensure every line of code meets the highest quality standards (and purr-factor). Got a project in mind? Tell me about it and I'll send you a free quote.

beatbox.desc: Interactive beat sequencer in the browser using Web Audio API. Features percussion pads, tempo control, preset patterns, and real-time visualization. Pure JavaScript and HTML/CSS.

lynx-moneyleaks.desc: Mobile-first personal finance web app. Tells you how much you can safely spend today after protecting income, expenses, debts, and savings. Actively built with Angular, .NET 10, and PostgreSQL.
